title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30362: add OnPostDocumentLinesOnBeforeInsertPostedHeaders event to Service-Post
summary: A new integration event OnPostDocumentLinesOnBeforeInsertPostedHeaders enables extensions to control which posted service document is created during service posting, matching the extensibility available in Sales-Post.
key_points: New IsHandled integration event added to Service-Post codeunit
Raised in PostDocumentLines before posted service invoice or credit memo header creation
Allows extensions to replace the standard decision on which posted document type to create
Brings Service-Post extensibility feature parity with Sales-Post
Change propagated across W1, NA, and IT layers
